last_scene.summary: Arlequino performed the exact user-supplied adapted text of 'Космос'. Opening images of love, chocolate, flowers and dreams drew immediate attention. 'Но ты пахнешь на шестнадцать' caused mixed and uneasy reactions from some listeners. Unfamiliar expressions such as 'наркота', 'кило', 'магикулы', 'ставки', 'папира' and 'сеаер' were not treated as concepts the Eurazanian audience automatically understood. The guarded-caravan/robbery comparison landed strongly with road-fighters and caravan people; catapult and arrow imagery drew rough laughter and winces. Dwargon was a concrete recognizable anchor. The repeated 'Навсегда' / 'В космос ты, в космос я' refrain became the easiest communal hook and was taken up by a large part of the yard. The healer woman watched with raised-brow amusement after earlier public banter, but no private meaning was assumed. Reactions remained heterogeneous. Tips +28s64c; expenses 0; net +28s64c. Personal cash became 23g20s60c.

Arlequino remains on the low wooden box with violin; guitar remains with Rena. Personal cash 23g20s60c. User controls Arlequino's next words/actions.
